payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple methods for evaluating the quality of data, particularly in the context of translations and transcripts.

claims.text: Quality of data is evaluated using sentence-level BLEU scores between human and automatic translations, with low scores leading to manual inspection.
Manual inspections are conducted for translations with high perplexity and low ratios of English characters, ensuring quality control.
The stability of model outputs is assessed using average coefficients of variation and normalized quality scores (BLEU_MS) across different speakers.
